output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is redundant due to the subsequent assert(c >= a) in add function, and it can be bypassed if the a + b overflows.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] += value; assert(c >= a); return c; in add function can be bypassed if a + b overflows.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value); in add function can be bypassed if a + b overflows.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increaseApproval function in the output list can be bypassed if _addedValue overflows.
The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); in sub function can be bypassed if oldValue overflows.
The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); in sub function can be bypassed if oldValue overflows.
The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] -= value; totalSupply -= value; in sub function can be bypassed if value overflows.
The setMigrationAgent function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The migrationAgent = _agent; in setMigrationAgent function can be bypassed if _agent overflows.
The setMigrationMaster function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The migrationMaster = _master; in setMigrationMaster function can be bypassed if _master overflows.
